Vietnam Airlines Flight Makes Emergency Landing in Chennai

A Vietnam Airlines flight bound for Sri Lanka made an emergency landing at Chennai International Airport due to an engine malfunction. The aircraft, a Boeing 737, experienced a technical issue mid-air, prompting the diversion. Three passengers reportedly suffered minor injuries, according to the airline.
